items.question: What sweet treat did Bella find on page 1?

options.text: Big yellow apples from the high tree.
Sweet carrots to put in her basket.
Round red berries from the bush.

items.question: What did the other animals bring for Bella on page 8?

options.text: Crunchy nuts from the oak tree.
Sweet berries for a nice big feast.
Fresh green grass from the meadow.

items.question: Why did Bella feel happy resting in her log home?

options.text: She ate every carrot all alone.
She took a long nap outside.
She thought about her smiling friends.

items.evidence_quote: Bella feels so warm and happy remembering their joyful smiles.
items.explain: Look: Bella feels happy remembering the joyful smiles of her friends.

items.question: Why was sharing treats a good choice for Bella?

options.text: Sharing brought joy to Bella and friends.
Sharing helped her run super fast.
Sharing made her basket very heavy.

items.evidence_quote: Sharing will bring Bella and her friends more joy.

talk_about: Bella felt happy when she shared her food. What is something special you like to share with your friends?
